stem:
Vihaan compares calendars used in India. He reads that the Indian National Calendar is an official solar calendar used along with the Gregorian calendar.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The Indian National Calendar is an official solar calendar.
It is used along with the Gregorian calendar.
The Indian National Calendar is only a lunar calendar and is not solar.
Official use means it replaces the Gregorian calendar completely.

teacher.key_rationale: The Indian National Calendar is official and solar, and it is used along with the Gregorian calendar, not only as lunar and not as a full replacement.
